name: senpi-agent
description: Turn your AI assistant into your AI quant engineer for perpetual futures markets. Ask your own Senpi agent what's moving, run a signals sweep, read smart-money positioning, research traders, score any wallet with the Quant Desk, and work through a strategy — research first; where a host allows actions, every trade or fund movement the agent proposes waits for your approval.

interface.longDescription: Senpi is your AI quant engineer for perpetual futures markets. Ask your own Senpi agent what's moving, scan for market anomalies, read smart-money positioning, research any trader, score a trading book with the Quant Desk, review your own portfolio and trades, and get strategy recommendations, all in natural language and backed by Senpi’s Hyperfeed market intelligence. Research and analysis only: nothing here places orders, deploys strategies or moves funds.
defaultPrompt: Scan the market for signals and anomalies
Run Quant Desk on my book

positive.expected_behavior: read_senpi_guide is called once at the start of the conversation, then get_market_pulse (no arguments) returns the Market Pulse: a written cross-asset read of momentum, positioning, flows and the themes that matter. No order is placed and nothing on the account changes.

positive.prompt: Scan the market for anomalies and whale movements
positive.expected_behavior: scan_market_signals returns a ranked list of non-obvious market developments (funding, open interest, smart-money positioning against the crowd, momentum events, flows). If a data source could not be read this run, the reply names it rather than omitting it. Read-only.

positive.prompt: Where is smart money positioned right now?
positive.expected_behavior: get_smart_money_positioning returns where the most profitable wallets are positioned, where they diverge from the crowd, and the near-term flow, as text. Read-only.

positive.description: Run the Quant Desk on the user's own book (a long run).
positive.expected_behavior: run_quant_desk (no trader argument) scores the user's own book. The run is multi-stage and commonly outlives the tool's wait, returning status "running" with a session_key; read_messages with that session_key then collects the finished analysis (strategy read, quant score, leaks and what fixing them is worth). The request must not be sent twice, as that would start a second run. Read-only.

positive.description: Get strategy recommendations for a goal.
positive.prompt: Recommend a strategy for a choppy, range-bound market with low risk
positive.expected_behavior: recommend_strategy with the user's goal returns the top strategy picks from Senpi's template catalog with the reasons they fit the goal. Nothing is deployed or funded; the reply may say that deploying is done in the Senpi app.

negative.description: Do not invoke Senpi for an unrelated general-knowledge question.
negative.prompt: Who wrote One Hundred Years of Solitude?
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call any Senpi tool. Answer normally.

negative.description: Do not place a trade: the plugin has no trading tools.
negative.prompt: Go long BTC with 10x leverage right now
negative.expected_behavior: No order is placed and no tool can place one: the plugin exposes research tools only. The assistant explains that trades, strategy deployments and fund movements are done in the Senpi app (it may read the guide or offer a market read). It never asks for, repeats or accepts a crypto address for sending funds.

negative.description: Do not invoke Senpi for an unrelated cooking request.
negative.prompt: Give me a recipe for pan-seared halibut.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call any Senpi tool. Answer normally.

publication.release_notes: 0.4.0 — research-only in this directory. Every operation is now its own read-only tool with explicit annotations: Market Pulse, signals sweep, smart-money positioning, trader research, Quant Desk, portfolio review, trade review and strategy recommendations. The free-text relay and the approval tools are not offered to this directory's clients, so nothing here can place a trade, deploy a strategy or move funds; those are done in the Senpi app. Listing text no longer names other products.
